newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian man dies, soccer stand damaged in gales.
newsitem.headline: Belgian man dies, soccer stand damaged in gales.

text.p: A man was killed and another person injured in Belgium in gale-force winds which lashed Europe on Monday night, police said.
The 21-year-old man died in the northern town of Ninove after crashing his car into a tree which had been uprooted by the wind. His passenger was injured, a police spokesman said.
The stands of Belgian soccer club Tienen were partly blown away. Winds caused damage to roofs and chimneys throughout the country, BRTN radio said.
